verdict.rationale: Expensify's 'Ask Expensify AI' lets users approve/reject/categorize expenses and get instant spend answers conversationally, showing some conversational-policy capability, but there's no evidence of it proactively chasing missing receipts, explaining declines, or answering 'can I expense this?' before spend occurs. Community evidence also flags inconsistent categorization accuracy, raising doubts about reliability of any automated policy judgments. Missing for 10: proactive receipt-chasing workflow, decline-explanation feature, pre-spend policy Q&A, and independent verification of AI accuracy on these tasks.
